evidence.detail: Person view has no door prize or credit fields; no doorprize data is passed to or displayed on the player page
set_doorprize() inserts into doorprize table but there is no function to query credit owed per person or track paid status
POST /api/doorprize endpoint records a winner but there is no mechanism to mark credit as paid or expose owed credit via the site

triage.notes: Feature requires new data infrastructure (querying doorprize by person, tracking paid/unpaid state), new person-page UI, and possibly an admin interface to mark credit as issued — scope is bigger than easy-fix and the 'credited' state needs a product definition.
